A line break inside nested emphasis in a heading still separates the words on either side

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<h2><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><em><br></em></strong>Beta</h2>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
